_comment: CAUSE-POSES (1 Nov 2026): roster-wide hurt/faint settle for every rig (F36 recipes and own-clip/remake species), scripts/creatures/creature_pose_settle.gd. The master `enabled` (OFF) is the GPU arm; each section keeps its own switch (ON inside the arm) so an arm can drop one. faint.grounded: dense pivot keys plant every faint sample on the standing ground line and re-centre the posed body over its contact shadow. faint.side_lie: rolls about the body's forward axis until the legs lie out to the side; a standing or crouched faint takes roll_sign (+1 rolls the back toward the body's right), a faint already on a side or legs-up keeps its side. faint.head_lift: the neck lifts a buried or downward head at faint end. faint.upright_splay: shelled and many-legged species splay their upper limbs so the body settles flat. faint.face_camera: at play_faint the settled collapse turns (ramped, about its standing centre) so the body lies across the camera's view with its back toward the camera (no end-on blob, belly away). hit.recoil: a hit that barely moves gains a held pivot recoil. hit.grounded: every hit sample is planted (no hop). Composes with f36_pose_candidates.json flags (including roster_pose_r1) and creature_clip_flags.json: it reads whatever clip those leave.

side_lie._keep_side_why: A faint already on a side or legs-up keeps the side it fell to (CPU stage: a fixed roll_sign flipped Mudsnout, Galecrest and Stormursa over through upright); roll_sign only orients standing or crouched faints.
side_lie._upright_why: Shelled and many-legged bodies collapse flat on their own legs (CPU stage: Cragclaw stood on its shell rim when rolled; Mosshell's own faint lands belly-up): their target is legs-down.
side_lie._exclude_why: No roll at all: Voltarach's curled faint has no reliable leg axis (CPU probe: a 132 deg roll); Galecrest's own wing-collapse already lies on its side (creature_body.gd rest_roll_deg note).

upright_splay._why: Upright species (side_lie.upright_species) collapse onto splayed legs: each upper limb swings outward about the forward axis, so the grounded body settles flat instead of reading as standing.
